item.title: Towers of Babble: building a tower to heaven with Scrabble tiles
item.author: invalid@example.com (leee)
item.dc:creator: leee
item.content:encoded: View: https://youtu.be/N_1sV4z0Cc8 Elevator pitch: tower defense x Scrabble. The words you make from your tiles are the buildings you place on the map, and you can even spell meta words on the map using those buildings. I played a lot of TD games back in the flash days and this is an excellent twist on the genre. It also features an unexpectedly good drum n bass soundtrack.
